scope.summary: Turn the design's atomic resource-vector, byte-credit, cancellation, durability-position, staged-commit, and filesystem-capability rules into versioned contracts and executable models that broad feature work must consume.
in_scope: Define the immutable ResourceVector dimensions, per-job/global limits, all-or-nothing central grant, deterministic fairness/tie-break policy, RAII ownership, cancellation, and release semantics.

Define byte-credit acquisition, ownership transfer, simultaneous input/output reservation, spill behavior, item/byte queue occupancy, loss policy, and upstream backpressure for every variable-size stage.
Define separate received, validated-written-contiguous, and durable-contiguous positions and prohibit resume state beyond the durable prefix.

Define finite state models for job/cancel, admission, fragment/durability, sink, FFmpeg resource use, commit/archive, filesystem capability, and recovery transitions touched by the Phase 2 proof slice.
Define same-filesystem staged commit and startup reconciliation for every PREPARED, RENAMED, ARCHIVED, and CLEANED crash prefix, including torn/duplicate/reordered journal records.
Define supported filesystem capability profiles for atomic replace, synchronization, leases/locking, path confinement, cross-volume behavior, and explicit degraded or rejected modes.

Implement deterministic model, property, saturation, cancellation, and fault tests that falsify leaks, over-admission, starvation, hidden unbounded queues, false durability, corrupt resume, and false success.
Expose stable structured model traces, invariant IDs, occupancy, grants, transition reasons, and residual uncertainty for no-context diagnosis.
non_goals: Implementing the full scheduler, downloader, archive backend, FFmpeg adapter, or every product state machine.
Introducing adaptive concurrency before fixed deterministic policy passes correctness, saturation, cancellation, and equivalent-work gates.
Claiming universal filesystem atomicity, universal termination, zero data loss, or correctness beyond declared assumptions and capability profiles.
Allowing independent semaphores, optimistic checkpoints, unbounded queues, or watcher acknowledgement to become the product contract.
Reducing protocol, live, sink, collection, archive, or recovery scope to simplify the model.
dependencies: Canonical architecture, PR, and triggered deep gates implemented by fforager-xtask
Controlled clock, deterministic scheduler, model/property-test, and fault-injection support in fforager-testkit
Current platform documentation for Windows and Unix filesystem/process guarantees

required_outcomes: Atomic all-or-nothing resource-vector admission with deterministic bounded queue semantics and owned release
Byte-credit ownership and three monotonic durability positions with no resume beyond durable_contiguous
Idempotent fail-closed reconciliation for every declared commit prefix and malformed journal class
Exact platform capability profiles with unsupported confinement and cross-volume behavior rejected or degraded
Machine-readable deterministic counterexamples and independent review evidence
risk_cases: Composite permits are partially held or leaked on cancellation, error, or panic
Strict queue-head reservation creates an undocumented liveness ceiling
Simultaneous transform input and output are allocated before coupled byte reservation
A journal checkpoint outruns data or directory durability
Torn, duplicate, reordered, or checksum-invalid records are accepted beyond the prior valid prefix
Windows reparse points, cross-volume paths, or WSL v9fs are treated as stronger filesystems than proven
Model-only evidence is misrepresented as Ferric execution behavior

DIFF_ATTACK_SURFACES: Contract lens: attacked the 13-dimension resource vector, nine-stage credit schema, strict storage payloads, and exact public ownership boundaries for missing fields or partial grants.
Serial durability lens: attacked validate, data-sync, directory-sync, journal-append, and journal-sync ordering at every PREPARED, RENAMED, ARCHIVED, and CLEANED prefix.
State and recovery lens: attacked wrong initial actions, foreign jobs, stale leases, collisions, interrupted migration, false already-applied observations, and mismatched retries.
Resource and cancellation lens: attacked all-or-nothing saturation, FIFO head reservation, per-owner/global item and byte ceilings, and success/error/panic/cancel cleanup.
Integration lens: attacked the contract-to-core-to-testkit-to-xtask manifest linkage, filesystem profile evidence ceilings, and the future Ferric-consumer boundary.

Gate and report lens: attacked stale invocation receipts, mutated source fingerprints, missing report fields, semantic overclaims, fabricated typed results, and nested proof-integrity target isolation.

COUNTERFACTUAL_CHECKS: Mutating foreign-broker durability acknowledgement to return success made the standalone WP-009 command fail with the typed PositionDoesNotMatchEffect diagnostic.
Fabricating a current-looking invocation receipt for an older persisted report made the standalone command fail with WP009-E-EXECUTION-RECEIPT-STALE.
Removing queue bounds or permitting durability to outrun validated data is rejected by testkit::tests::resource_durability_report_rejects_missing_queue_bounds_and_durability_outrun.
Changing recovery output to claim non-idempotent convergence is rejected by testkit::tests::resource_durability_report_rejects_non_idempotent_recovery_claim.
Removing required report fields or changing semantic proof attribution is rejected by xtask::tests::wp009_report_validator_rejects_missing_fields_and_false_semantics.
BOUNDARY_PROBES: OwnedResourceBroker public requests prove complete-vector admission or exact FIFO queuing without exposing a mutable raw ledger.
OwnedByteCreditBroker public success, error, panic, and cancellation paths prove exact component, owner, stage, and zero-retained-credit outcomes.
StateMachine effect acknowledgement rejects cross-instance routing, foreign durability brokers, replay, and restoration without matching position evidence.
apply_recovery_action accepts only the oracle-selected action and exposes an opaque application whose retry accepts only the same bound action.
The xtask consumer re-parses the manifest and report, re-hashes current sources, checks the caller-created receipt, and independently validates every row.
NEGATIVE_PATH_CHECKS: Oversized, unmapped, duplicate, reordered, checksum-invalid, mixed-job, and incomplete journal inputs fail closed at the prior valid durable prefix.
Blank renamed identities, incomplete archive uniqueness evidence, unsupported path confinement, WSL-v9fs strengthening, and cross-volume atomicity claims are rejected.
Wrong-broker acknowledgements produce CreditError::AcknowledgementBrokerMismatch through executed public code rather than a hardcoded evidence label.
Missing proof fields, absent or stale receipts, source-manifest drift, false semantic labels, and platform overclaims fail the independent report validator.
StateMachine remains non-Clone at the public boundary, preventing replay through copied lifecycle authority, and compile-fail doctests enforce the boundary.

The proof report originally permitted hardcoded or stale evidence paths; executed typed counterexamples and caller-bound fresh receipts now make those mutations fail.

RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: The evidence is bounded pure-model prerequisite proof and does not execute a Ferric scheduler, downloader, archive adapter, or storage consumer.
Live platform probes establish only host and repository-mount identity; they do not execute crash, power-loss, atomic-replace, confinement-race, or durability experiments.
WSL2 exposes this repository through v9fs, so it cannot substantiate a native Linux filesystem durability profile.
The caller-created invocation receipt is process-local; persisted proof remains protected by independent report, manifest, freshness, and source-fingerprint revalidation.
No Ferric execution consumer exists; the model evidence remains prerequisite-only.
